title: Zenith Romantic Venezuelan Shiitake Mushrooms Wrap
description: A cultured and velvety Venezuelan dish featuring shiitake mushrooms in a romantic ssam-wrap, shojin-friendly style, perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat and add the olive oil.
Add the sliced shiitake mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they are tender and lightly browned.
In a small bowl, mix together the mashed avocado, lime juice, salt, and black pepper.
Warm the whole wheat tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spreading a quarter of the avocado mixture onto each tortilla, then topping with a quarter of the cooked mushrooms, some sliced red onion, and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro.
Serve the wraps immediately and enjoy.
Garnish with additional cilantro and lime wedges if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
